lina (DevEx): heads-up — running into a DX snag in the sampleapp rerank pipeline. embeddings helper returns mixed vector lengths in the same batch when an auth refresh triggers a retry. rerank expects uniform dims so the client blows up.

sam (SDK Eng): ugh. reproducible for you? steps? :eyes: 

lina (DevEx): yes. quick repro: run the sampleapp locally, call /v1/embeddings with a 4-item batch, force token refresh (short-lived creds). observed: one item comes back as 768-d while others 512-d. happens ~1/20 retries.

noah (Backend): can you paste a minimal snippet of the raw response?

lina (DevEx): sure — raw snippet: ```
# observed shapes from response parsing
response[0].embedding.length = 512
response[1].embedding.length = 768
response[2].embedding.length = 512
```

sam (SDK Eng): hmm. node SDK has a `padTo` helper that runs only on the first non-empty chunk; py SDK uses `normalize_embeddings` that gets called differently during retry flow. possible parity bug in retry path.

elaine (PM): is this causing customer-visible failures? any crash logs?

lina (DevEx): yes — rerank endpoint errs with `inconsistent vector dimensions` and the sampleapp returns 500. I saw one internal customer integration fail in staging yesterday.

sam (SDK Eng): I'll add defensive normalization on the client side (force all vectors to same length based on max in batch) and throw a warning. but we should fix root cause in server retry merging logic.

noah (Backend): quick theory: during auth refresh we re-issue the batch but the emb helper code path that applies quantization/reshape runs async and picks a different model variant for one item (different architecture -> different dim). server should pin model variant for a request id. logging shows alternating model_id: `open-embed-512-v1` vs `open-embed-768-v2` on the same batch.

lina (DevEx): that's consistent with what I traced. also noticed the SDK sometimes wraps embeddings as objects vs raw arrays: `[{vector: [...]}, [...]]` — the serializer tolerates both in the happy path but retry/merge assumes raw arrays.

sam (SDK Eng): thanks — I'll: 1) add a small normalization patch to node+py SDKs for immediate mitigation, 2) add strict assertions in sampleapp CI to catch mixed dims, 3) open a backend issue to pin model variant during retries.

elaine (PM): timeline? we should put a note in the release notes and notify support.

sam (SDK Eng): will open PR with client fix in ~2h. PR will include a unit test that simulates auth-refresh retry merging with mixed shapes.

ci-bot: Created PR #2244: sam/sdk-mitigate-vector-drift — "normalize embeddings on retry merge"

noah (Backend): I'll file backend issue and link PR. adding a canary rule to force consistent model selection for retried requests.

lina (DevEx): thanks folks. follow-ups: (a) add a small log line when normalization occurs so DX sees automatic fixes, (b) docs note about expected embedding dims and SDK behavior for retries.

sam (SDK Eng): noted. I'll add a short blurb to the SDK changelog and update sampleapp readme.

elaine (PM): ping me once PR merges, we'll coordinate a small support comms note. :thumbsup:
